# Pixel Task List

A fully offline, pixel-styled task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No storage, no network, no dependencies.

## Features

- Add tasks via input or Enter key (trims whitespace, ignores blank)
- Toggle completion with checkbox (updates remaining count)
- Delete tasks with per-task button (updates both counts)
- Live total and remaining counters
- Pixel-art aesthetic with system fonts and responsive layout (360px+)
- Keyboard accessible with labels and focus states

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. All state is in memory and resets on reload.

## Structure

- `index.html` – markup and required IDs
- `styles.css` – pixel theme and responsive styles
- `script.js` – task logic and DOM rendering

## Design Notes

Colors: dark blue background (#1a1c2c), card (#2a2d45), accent orange (#f4a261), danger red (#e76f51), border (#4a4e69). Pixel borders via thick solid borders and box-shadow. Hover/active/focus states on all controls.
